models._help: Each role is a chain 'provider:model'. The first is preferred; when it is busy (per-minute limit), at a daily limit, unavailable or down, the next one answers instantly. Providers: groq (GROQ_API_KEY), cloudflare (CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN + CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID), openrouter (OPENROUTER_API_KEY, free models only unless allow_paid_openrouter_models), gemini (GEMINI_API_KEY, vision = reading uploaded PDFs/images). For testing you can override a chain in .env, e.g. HQ_MODEL_AGENT=cloudflare:@cf/openai/gpt-oss-120b

_rate_limits_help: Tokens-per-minute limit per model, read from Groq's x-ratelimit headers for this account (Groq free tier: 8,000/min, 1,000 requests/day; gpt-oss also 200,000 tokens/day). OpenRouter free models: ~20 requests/min and 50/day on a key without credits. The app waits for per-minute limits and falls back along the chain for daily limits or outages.
_price_sheets_help: Add one entry per brand. type 'excel' = local .xlsx/.xlsm (re-read automatically when the file is saved). type 'google_sheets' = live Google Sheet: {"type": "google_sheets", "sheet_id": "<id from the URL>", "refresh_seconds": 300, "display_name": "..."} shared as 'anyone with the link can view'. multiplier_cell = the cell holding the price multiplier; its live value is shown to the agent and create_quote must match it. encrypted_path = encrypted copy committed to the repo (scripts/encrypt_price_sheet.py); used when the plain workbook isn't present, unlocked with PRICE_SHEET_KEY.

chat._help: max_message_chars: longest message a user can send. recent_exchanges_verbatim: how many recent user/assistant exchanges the agent sees word-for-word; older ones are folded into a running summary (nothing is lost: facts and quotes also live in long-term memory).

uploads._help: Per message: max_images images + max_pdfs PDFs, each up to max_file_mb; PDFs up to max_pdf_pages pages. Files are read by background Celery workers (redis_url); if no worker is running the app reads them in a background thread instead. render_dpi / max_image_side_px control how sharp PDF pages are for the vision model.
